models.systemPromptSuffix: Implement early and iteratively. Do not spend a full response on planning. Persist exact API response-shape requirements in REQUIREMENTS.md and audit them before finishing.
Reasoning strength: low. Write an implementation before detailed design, persist a requirements checklist, and always end planning with a tool call.
Use finite timeouts for tests and server commands. If a command stalls, stop it, diagnose, and continue rather than waiting indefinitely.
